k6 resolves ES modules on the FILESYSTEM and rejects bare specifiers outright, so this service's k6 load library cannot import the shared Clerk re-mint (packages/tools/loadtest/k6/session.js) by package name — verified against the k6 binary. The alternative is three copies of the refresh logic, whose absence cost run 34041143051 every authenticated request after 60 seconds.

Pre-existing deep import into a deployable service's source, carried from packages/infra/global when ADR-0066 moved the guard. turbo could not see it there. The durable fix is to move the guard into the service whose source it reads; that is a separate change.

A guard unit-tests a pure decision function exported by a repo-root `scripts/*.mjs` module, which is the only way to assert on the function rather than on a subprocess's stdout. The repo root is not a workspace, so there is no package to declare. The same import lived in packages/infra/global, where turbo could not see it, before ADR-0066 moved the guard here. Giving `scripts/` a workspace of its own would retire this entry.
